opportunities.idea: Segment the uploaded portfolio after governed ingestion.
opportunities.mechanism: Use portfolio attributes to form actionable clusters before recovery treatments are selected.
opportunities.potential_value: Allows different recovery treatments to be tested by segment instead of applying one generic flow.
opportunities.risk: Weak segments may overfit small samples.
opportunities.experiment: Compare baseline handling with three governed segments on the same offline sample.

opportunities.idea: Learn which portfolio attributes and treatments correlate with better outcomes.
opportunities.mechanism: Reuse historical upload and outcome data to improve future decision support.
opportunities.potential_value: Repeated portfolio loads can compound into reusable decision intelligence.
opportunities.risk: Correlation may be mistaken for causal effect.
opportunities.experiment: Backtest recommendations on historical labeled outcomes before any live automation.

opportunities.idea: Evolve the upload entry point into an offline recovery-strategy simulator.
opportunities.mechanism: Compare alternative treatment policies on the same portfolio before operational commitment.
opportunities.potential_value: Changes the product from ingestion-only into a pre-execution decision surface.
opportunities.risk: Simulation validity depends on data quality and counterfactual assumptions.
opportunities.experiment: Build an offline sandbox that scores multiple treatment policies and records uncertainty.
